author: Ankit
problem: badge_scans lists the room numbers where a visitor's badge was scanned, in time order (None means a failed scan). Return the distinct rooms in the order the visitor first entered them.
bug_description: Removes duplicates with set(), which throws away the order of first visits.

comments.accurate: Distinct rooms in the order they were first visited, ignoring failed scans
comments.wrong_behavior: Distinct rooms the visitor went to, ignoring failed scans
comments.wrong_location: Duplicate removal verified; check that failed scans are filtered out
